verdict.rationale: Mesh docs say customers, defined as a person or company, can be screened against a global database of sanctions, warning, fitness-and-probity and watchlists. Screening configurations let teams choose the appropriate screening lists, and multiple configurations can be created and selected per customer. Screening runs synchronously, asynchronously, or in batch. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how individual sanctions or watchlists are chosen within a configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of screening results.
